UPSC Pods · Content preview, parts 2 to 5

Fifty-nine new ways to learn, and the templates that make more

Each piece has its own sound effects and motion, plays to an end, and keeps sound off until you turn it on. All 70 content types now have a template, tagged by exam stage, paper and question format, so a small model can fill fresh content from a source text. The 52 newest run on nine shared engines, so the app needs nine renderers, not fifty-two.

Sound kit

Twelve short effects and five soundscapes, all synthesized, so they add almost nothing to the app's size. Each is exported as Opus (.ogg) and AAC (.m4a) under content/audio/sfx/. Templates name effects by id, so swapping in a recorded sound later changes no content.

Effects play only after the member turns sound on, never on TRAGIC content, and peak well below the music beds. Turn sound on above to try them.

Pick a type to see what a writer fills, the word limits, and the prompt a small model gets. Edit the JSON and press Check: the same validator the batch tool uses runs here, including the house rules (Hindi parity, tone, banned phrases, and numbers that are not in the source).
